availability.statement: Search is an early-beta capability; response fields and availability can change.

common_pitfalls: Search finds Tiingo assets by ticker or name; it does not search news articles.
Queries must be nonblank and no longer than 256 characters.
Treat beta response fields as vendor-owned rather than a frozen schema.
description: Early-beta Tiingo asset search by ticker or name.
ticker_format: Nonblank ticker or asset-name query text
workflows: Search with the narrowest useful ticker/name text.
Use the returned identifier with the matching asset-family metadata tool.

request_controls.filters: exact_ticker_match and include_delisted are optional booleans; limit must be 1 to 100. Omitted controls preserve Tiingo defaults.
